selectPrompt: Select a song on the left to review and edit it before importing.
allPresent: Your library already contains every song from this source.

error.failed: Couldn't load the catalog. Check your connection and try again.

editorHint: Edits here apply only to the imported copy. Nothing is saved until you import.

settings.title: Song updates
settings.description: A little after the app starts, and then every day, Church Hub checks your song sources when there is internet. New songs, and newer versions of songs you never edited, sync on their own: a song you edited is never replaced. Songs you may already have under another title wait for you in Download songs.
settings.enableLabel: Sync new songs and updates without asking
settings.enableHint: When off, they wait in the notifications until you sync them.

songSources.title: Song sources
songSources.description: Where Song discovery finds new songs. Add sources from links others share, and share your own categories as a file or a link.

links.title: Sources from links
links.description: Paste a link someone shared with you: a .chsongs file or a manifest.json. Its songs show up in Song discovery.

export.title: Song file
export.description: Save a category's songs: as a .chsongs file anyone with Church Hub can open, as a .zip of OpenSong files for other programs, or as a .zip of PowerPoint files.

storage.title: Your S3 storage
storage.description: To share categories by link, connect an S3-compatible bucket (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO). The secret key stays on this computer.
storage.secretKept: Saved; leave empty to keep it

publish.title: Shared categories
publish.description: Each shared category stays in sync with the bucket: every 5 minutes, only the songs that changed are uploaded. Send the link to whoever should get the songs.

page.title: Download the latest songs
page.description: New songs from your song sources that aren't in your library yet.

addLink.label: Link to a song file
addLink.placeholder: Paste a link to a .chsongs file

notification.checkingDescription: New songs and updates arrive here when it is done. The app stays fast meanwhile.
